questions.stem: What causes the 'lub-dub' sounds of the heartbeat?

options.text: Blood hitting the walls of the ventricles
The contraction of the atria and ventricles
Blood flowing through the coronary arteries

questions.explanation: The heart sounds are caused by valves closing. The 'lub' is the atrioventricular valves closing at the start of ventricular systole, and the 'dub' is the semilunar valves closing at the start of diastole.
